{{Top|leg}}
'''Administrator''' was a title held by employees of [[Outer Rim Oreworks Company|Outer Rim Oreworks]] (ORO) who were responsible for the management of any mining interests of ORO in a certain location, such as a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

An Administrator was supposed to be profitable for ORO, so any mines under his jurisdiction were to give benefits.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> ORO provided Administrators with technology, sometimes leading to the mines being fully automated and requiring no organic intervention. ORO regularly sent inspectors to a mine, and the Administrator was to pay ORO for this privilege.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

An Administrator could either decide who would replace him,<ref name="BL" /> or his post could be revoked, whereupon a new Administrator would be chosen. In certain cases, should ORO abandon their assets in a certain location, an Administrator could be elected to manage the mines.<ref name="R" />

Any other ORO employee with lower rank in the area was to answer to the local Administrator,<ref name="BL" /> even if the Administrator ordered that person to perform a task outside their area of expertise.<ref name="R" />

For all these reasons, [[Hugo Bartyn]], who worked for the [[Exploratory branch of Outer Rim Oreworks|exploratory branch]] of ORO, took advantage of his opportunity to become the Administrator of the ORO mines of the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. He was a successful manager, and in the following five centuries, his descendants replaced him as Administrators.<ref name="BL" /> Eventually, a few years before the Battle of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], ORO abandoned his mines in Lamaredd, the Administrator's power was revoked and a public election was held to choose a new Administrator.<ref name="R" />
